_comment: The three-step ALVSolutions process. process-steps.njk reads this, so the sequence exists in one place instead of being retyped per page. `note` is a payment/status caption for each step, kept here for the future homepage — the current process-steps.njk component has no slot for it yet and wasn't given one this pass.
sentence: Tell me what you need. I design and build it. We go live.
_homeComment: The homepage's wording for the same three steps: it sells websites, branding and graphics, so its steps cover all three. Icons and payment notes come from `steps` (process.njk matches them by position). The service pages keep `steps` as written.

homeSteps.detail: Share your business, what you're trying to accomplish and where you need help.
You see the project as it comes together, not only when it's finished.
Your website goes live or your finished assets are delivered ready to use.

steps.detail: You tell me about the business, your customers and what the site has to do. I ask the questions that decide the rest of the build.
You see the site as it comes together, not only at the end. Revision rounds are part of the price, not an upsell.
You own the domain. I connect it to your site, set up the hosting and handle the launch, then stay available for the updates that come after.
steps.note: Remaining 50% due at your approval, before publishing
